senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; cmp. גֵּו)crowd, people, nation; pl. גּוֹיִם gentiles, fr. which גּוֹי = נָכְרִי or עכו״ם, gentile, idolator.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 3:4">Tosef. Ab. Zar. III, 4</cite> sq.; Y. ib. IV, 41ᵃ top contrad. to <cite ref="K00424"><he>כותי</he></cite> (Bab.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 29a">ib. 29ᵃ</cite> <cite ref="N00847"><he>נכרי</he></cite>); a. v. fr.—Pl. <he>גּוֹיִים</he>, <he>גּוֹיִם</he>.

Ab. Zar. I, 1 sq. in Y. ed. ג׳ (Bab. ed. נכרים, עכו״ם, Mish. עכומ״ז, נכרים indiscriminately); a. v. fr.—Fem. גּוֹיָה gentile woman. Y. Yeb. II, 4ᵃ top ואין בנך מן הג׳ וכ׳ thy son from a gentile is not called thy son but her son (Bab.

<cite ref="Yevamot 23a:12">ib. 23ᵃ</cite> <he>נכרית</he>); a. fr.—Pl. <he>גּוֹיוֹת</he>. Y. ib. IV, 6ᵃ bot. [Y. Gitt. I, 43ᵇ top, a. e. <he>גויים לוקין</he>, v. <cite ref="C00663"><he>גַּיּוּס</he></cite>.]
